title: BearCase
description: Gate G4 artifact. The bear agent is the closest thing this system has to a test suite. If it cannot produce four falsifiable objections, that is a failure of the bear agent, not evidence that the thesis is sound.

mechanism.description: The specific causal chain by which this hurts the investment. Not a category label like 'competition'.

falsifiable_test.description: A concrete observation that would settle this either way, e.g. 'if Q1 datacenter revenue grows under 15% YoY, the saturation objection holds'.

kill_criteria.description: Feeds directly into ThesisRecord.invalidation_triggers and the monitor agent's watch list.

threshold.description: Numeric and unambiguous. 'Margins deteriorate' is not a threshold; 'gross margin below 40% for two consecutive quarters' is.

steelman_verdict.description: The bear agent's honest read on the strongest bull argument, stated fairly before disagreeing with it.
